description: MCP server for Siglio. Lets an AI assistant send documents for e-signature by email or text.
name: com.esigndev/siglio-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Your Siglio API key. Sandbox keys start with sig_sandbox_ and live keys start with sig_live_. Get one at https://esigndev.com
environmentVariables.name: SIGLIO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow a live key. Without it, live keys are refused and only sandbox keys will run. Leave unset while testing.
environmentVariables.name: SIGLIO_ALLOW_LIVE
